name: bitg
description: Write and convert Uzbek text in the new 2026 Uzbek Latin alphabet (Ö Ğ Ş Ç) with the deterministic bitg engine. Converts old Latin (o‘ g‘ sh ch, any apostrophe) and Cyrillic to the new alphabet and back, keeping English words, names, links and code intact.

interface.longDescription:
bitg writes and converts Uzbek text in the new Uzbek Latin alphabet adopted in 2026 (Ö ö, Ğ ğ, Ş ş, Ç ç; in force from 22 April 2027).

AI assistants often guess the new spelling: they replace every sh and ch, break English words and names, and miss apostrophe variants. bitg uses a rule-based engine with Uzbek and English dictionaries instead, the same engine as the bitg keyboard and the converter at bitg.uz.

- Old Latin (o‘ g‘ sh ch, any apostrophe) or Cyrillic to the new alphabet
- Back to old Latin or to Cyrillic
- English words, names, links and code stay unchanged

One read-only tool, no sign-in. Text is converted in memory and not stored.
capabilities: Convert old Latin or Cyrillic Uzbek text to the new 2026 alphabet
Convert new alphabet text back to old Latin or Cyrillic
defaultPrompt: Convert this to the new Uzbek alphabet: O‘zbekiston shaharlari

positive.description: Convert old Latin Uzbek text to the new alphabet
positive.prompt: Convert to the new Uzbek alphabet: O‘zbekiston shaharlari, choyxona va G‘afur G‘ulom ko‘chasi.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_text with direction to_new and returns: Özbekiston şaharlari, çoyxona va Ğafur Ğulom köçasi.

positive.description: Convert Cyrillic Uzbek text to the new Latin alphabet
positive.prompt: Write this in the new Uzbek Latin alphabet: Чой ичамиз, кейин шаҳарга борамиз.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_text with direction to_new and returns: Çoy içamiz, keyin şaharga boramiz.

positive.description: Mixed Uzbek and English text keeps English words
positive.prompt: Convert to the new Uzbek alphabet and keep the English words: Please check the schedule, keyin choy ichamiz.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns: Please check the schedule, keyin çoy içamiz. The English words check, schedule are unchanged.

positive.description: Convert new alphabet text to Uzbek Cyrillic
positive.prompt: Convert Özbekiston şaharlari to Uzbek Cyrillic.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_text with direction to_cyrillic and returns: Ўзбекистон шаҳарлари.

positive.description: Convert new alphabet text back to old Latin with plain apostrophes
positive.prompt: Convert Özbekiston to the old Uzbek Latin alphabet using a plain ASCII apostrophe.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_text with direction to_old and old_style ascii and returns: O'zbekiston.

negative.description: Translation request, not alphabet conversion. The plugin converts script only and should not be used; the assistant translates on its own.
negative.prompt: Translate 'Good morning, how are you?' into Japanese.

negative.description: Non-Uzbek text. Conversion does not apply to French; the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: Fix the spelling in this French sentence: Je vais a la plage demain.

negative.description: Request unrelated to text conversion (weather). The plugin has no such capability and should not be called.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Tashkent today?

review.commerce_description: No commerce. bitg is free and has no purchases.

publication.release_notes: First release: convert_text tool for the new 2026 Uzbek Latin alphabet (to_new, to_old, to_cyrillic).
